item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"German law defines political parties as constitutionally necessary components of the free democratic basic order, assigns them a public role in forming political will, requires them to state their goals in political programs, and limits use of party funds to legally assigned party functions.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.6","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence that Olaf Scholz personally enacted, implemented, or complied with these provisions.","limitations":["The source does not describe Scholz's conduct, decisions, or outcomes during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The party-law framework requires equal treatment in public benefits, written party statutes and programs, regular disclosure of leadership information, member participation, elected party organs, secret elections for party leadership and electoral candidates, minority proposal rights, and independent party arbitration courts not bound by instructions.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","4B.7","4B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence that Scholz personally protected or enforced these safeguards.","limitations":["The source establishes formal rules but provides no evidence about their practical enforcement or Scholz's role."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"State party financing is subject to vote- and contribution-based formulas, relative and absolute funding ceilings, application and reporting deadlines, Bundestag-President review, possible provisional payment with security, repayment and correction procedures, publication of reports, and Federal Court of Auditors review of the funding process.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.4","5B.5","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence that Scholz personally supported, directed, or interfered with these controls.","limitations":["The source does not identify any 2023 review, audit result, breach, or Scholz action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The law prohibits or restricts specified political donations, including anonymous donations above €500, donations given in expectation of a particular economic or political advantage, certain public-sector and foreign donations, and undisclosed large contributions; prohibited donations must be forwarded to the Bundestag President.","question_ids":["4B.2","7B.3","7B.4","7B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence that Scholz personally complied with or enforced the restrictions.","limitations":["No fact in the source links Scholz or his office to a particular donation, conflict, or enforcement action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":20,"end_unit":22,"fact_summary":"Party financial reports must be independently audited; auditors must be impartial and free of specified conflicts; identified inaccuracies can require correction, repayment, or multiplied financial claims; unlawful or undisclosed donations can trigger claims of twice or three times the relevant amount; deliberate false reporting can be criminally punished by up to three years' imprisonment or a fine.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.5","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","7B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence that Scholz personally accepted, directed, or faced these sanctions.","limitations":["The source reports legal mechanisms rather than a 2023 case, finding, correction, or sanction involving Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02e829672c20374b","start_unit":23,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The framework provides enforcement mechanisms for unconstitutional-party judgments and allows the Federal Returning Officer or Bundestag President to compel required party filings through coercive fines, with specified authorities responsible for execution.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.4","4B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Institutional framework applicable during 2023; the supplied text is a current consolidated version and includes later amendments.","ruler_attribution":"This is a statutory institutional finding, not evidence of a Scholz-directed enforcement action during 2023.","limitations":["The source does not state that these powers were used in relation to Scholz, his party, or the federal government in 2023."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is a statutory text, not a contemporaneous account of Olaf Scholz's decisions or performance in 2023.","The consolidated text states that it was amended on 27 February 2024, so provisions should not be treated as direct evidence of the precise law in force throughout 2023 without version verification.","No source fact materially addresses chapters 1B, 2B, 3B, 5B, or 6B beyond general institutional context."]}
